feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 29 September 2026 11:59am
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Mainly dry with bright spells at first but then cloud tending to increase as the day progresses. Rain then arriving overnight into Wednesday, becoming heavy for a time.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20, risk 20-40 hills.


##Wind Speed##

27


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

E or SE 20-25, increasing 25-35 through the morning with gusts 45-50 in places in the evening, veering S 10-20 overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog soon becoming widespread.


##Comments##

Heavy rain overnight may lead to localised surface water flooding. Strong to gale force winds. Coastal overtopping around times of high tide (~1:30pm & ~2am Wed).


##Today##

Rain at first quickly clearing with sunny intervals developing as well as the risk of the odd shower.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S 10-20, increasing 20-32, veering SW 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Hill fog becoming isolated.


##Comments##

Strong winds for a time. Risk of coastal overtopping around times of high tide (~2:15pm & ~2:45am Thu).


##Tomorrow##
